provided.title: File:Uhuru Park in Nairobi, Kenya, during sunset.jpg

observed.caption: A wide view of a grassy urban park with ponds and scattered people in the foreground and a cluster of modern high-rise buildings in the background under a pale sky.
observed.description: In the foreground a grassy area with patches of dirt, rocks, and small plants slopes down to a wide dirt path where several small figures are walking and a group sits on the grass to the left. Beyond the path are two small ponds with green footbridges, surrounded by mown lawns, trees, and two small white buildings with turquoise trim on the right. A dark lamppost and a palm tree stand on the right side near the path, and a large leafy tree fills the left edge. In the midground an elevated roadway stretches horizontally behind the park, lined with trees and lower buildings. The background is dominated by several tall skyscrapers of varying designs, including a brown reflective tower on the right, twin blue-glass towers in the center, and a cylindrical tower on the left, all lit by warm daylight under a pale blue sky with light clouds.
